en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy outdoor public swimming pool full of children and adults. People are wading, swimming and standing at the pool edge in old-fashioned bathing suits. In the background are trees, a low rectangular building and a wooden tower-like structure beside the pool. The scene appears leisurely and summery. In the lower right corner, printed text labels the place.
